[Privacy Policy](PRIVACY.md)

## What the extension provides

Roblox Customizer is an independent browser extension for appearance customization and convenience tools on Roblox. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Roblox Corporation. Roblox and other third-party names and marks belong to their owners.

Full functionality currently supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Indonesian Roblox settings. Other languages use a limited mode with image/GIF backgrounds and custom colors. Availability also depends on your browser, Roblox, and external services, which may change or become unavailable. No promise is made that every feature will always work.

## Responsible use and your content

Use the extension lawfully and follow the terms of Roblox and any services you access. It does not authorize bypassing account permissions, platform restrictions, or security measures, and does not provide free Robux or ownership of items.

You are responsible for the backgrounds, URLs, and other content you choose. Use content you own or have permission to use, respect others' rights and privacy, and avoid malicious files or links. Choosing a file for a local background does not transfer its ownership to the publisher.

Keep your browser and extension up to date and protect your device and account. Do not give the publisher or others your Roblox password or session cookies.

## Estimates, third parties, and saved data

Playtime, server country, ping, game statistics, and currency values are estimates or third-party information. They may be incomplete, delayed, or inaccurate. Currency equivalents are informational, not an exchange service or guaranteed checkout price. Verify important details with the original service.

External websites, feeds, media, and APIs are operated by their respective providers under their own terms and policies. The publisher does not control their availability, accuracy, or content.

Saved extension data belongs to your browser profile and is not a cloud backup. Export a backup before reset, import, uninstall, or changing devices. Import can replace existing data, and resets or browser cleanup can delete it. The publisher cannot recover data stored only on your device. The extension does not back up Roblox purchases, balances, or game progress.
